# Veyra 0.2.1+mc1.21.11

Patch release for Minecraft 1.21.11 and VulkanMod 0.6.8.

## Changes

- Remove repeated GLSL identifier scans from entity submissions. Analyze usage at pipeline preparation, skip unused identifier variants, and cache shadow-program presence for each pack configuration.
- Restore sharp magnification of block textures with shader packs while retaining mipmaps and anisotropic minification. Custom block-atlas aliases use Minecraft's sampler.
- Apply alpha testing after terrain and entity shader-pack fragment programs, including early returns, so transparent parts of vegetation and entity textures do not write opaque color and depth.
- Separate camera bob/hurt effects from projection for shader-pack depth reconstruction, reflections and shadows. Keep entity vertex and normal transforms consistent without applying camera effects twice.

## Installation

Requires Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer, VulkanMod 0.6.8, and Java 21 or newer.

Put `veyra-0.2.1+mc1.21.11.jar` in the instance's `mods` folder beside VulkanMod and remove older Veyra JARs. The sources JAR is for development. Press F6 to select and configure a shader pack.

## Validation and limits

- Local JDK 21 checks: 617 tests passed; 104 example shaders processed and 122 direct Vulkan SPIR-V modules compiled. The BSL v10.1.8 default source audit passed with no capability or adapter errors.
- The user tested development builds in their Modrinth profile and reported that freezes were gone and block textures were sharper. These reports are not a benchmark or a full-pack compatibility certification.
- Alpha cutoff and camera-matrix changes have CPU regression tests and shader compilation coverage. The intermittent black-screen report has not been reproduced under a controlled graphics test; its resolution is not confirmed.
- Publication is gated by the repository's pinned shader-pack source audit, Lavapipe graphics matrix, build/tests, example packaging and distributable verification.
- Existing shader-pack compatibility limits remain: see COMPATIBILITY.md. Full Iris visual parity, all profiles, and natural-world rendering are not certified.

# Veyra 0.2.0+mc1.21.11

Veyra runs a documented subset of Iris/OptiFine shader-pack programs on VulkanMod. This release adds the 0.2 rendering pipeline, shader-pack options and profiles, compute resources, and the lighting, entity and shadow corrections developed through the beta series. Supported profiles and measured limits are listed in COMPATIBILITY.md.

## Changes

- Load ZIP and directory shader packs, select them with F6, and configure saved per-pack options and quality profiles.
- Run supported terrain, entity, block-entity, hand, sky, cloud, weather, particle and post programs with checked vertex/fragment interfaces, MRT and depth inputs.
- Support the documented compute families, shared custom images, SSBOs and validated direct/indirect dispatch.
- Feed live loose uniforms, honor `oldLighting` and shadow-entity toggles, and convert entity color overlays with Iris semantics.
- Preserve OpenGL shadow-map texture coordinates and clip depth on Vulkan, including native vertex fallbacks and face winding. The natural golem cast shadow now appears in the matched Complementary HIGH scene.
- Reconstruct missing fluid normals, align post-pass projection coordinates and shader-pack inverse projections, and preserve world and hand depth for final passes.
- Restore Iris shadow-view rotations and camera snapping, synchronize terrain shadow texture binding, and allow declared block-entity shadow vertex storage-image writes.
- Route sign text through Iris BlockTrans with the matching vertex stage and alpha cutoff. A matched generated Sildur sign fixture on a prerelease candidate measured glyph-mask IoU 0.9333; it was not repeated on the final candidate. A separate fresh c341 scene showed a blank sign on both Iris and Veyra, so it does not establish readability in that scene.
- Drain deferred Vulkan image frees before allocator destruction; validate resize, dimension changes, pack disable/re-enable and resource reload.

## Installation

- Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer, VulkanMod 0.6.8, and Java 21 or newer.
- Put `veyra-0.2.0+mc1.21.11.jar` beside VulkanMod in the instance mods folder. Remove older Veyra JARs and keep the sources JAR out of the instance.
- Put shader-pack folders or ZIPs in `shaderpacks`. Press F6 to select a pack; use Configure / Apply for its supported options and profiles.

## Validation and limits

- Exact merged-main JDK 21 gate at `c242eb8`: 607 tests, 0 failures/errors/skips; 104 example shaders and 122 direct Vulkan SPIR-V modules; build, GraphicsSmoke compilation, and example-pack packaging passed. Two existing Mixin mapping warnings remain in `GameRendererMixin`.
- Pinned source audit at `c242eb8`: four packs, three dimensions, 12 defaults and 63 profile cases; 939 geometry fragments accepted, none rejected; all 18 active compute stages compiled. This is source-only evidence.
- The PR #145 code tree (head `b1fff75`, now merged as `c242eb8`) passed all 30 hosted Lavapipe Graphics jobs. RTX 3070 lifecycle runs passed for Complementary Reimagined HIGH (360,000 pixels / 134 buckets), BSL HIGH (360,000 / 126), Sildur default (360,000 / 160), and Unbound COMPLEMENTARY (360,000 / 122), including resize, dimension round-trip, disable/re-enable and resource reload.
- A matched Complementary HIGH direct Fresnel probe matched Iris in an 8,700-pixel ROI. The water basin ROI RGB MAE is 13.87 against Iris, but a same-main old-matrix baseline did not render because VulkanMod rejected generated `copy_*` / `depthtex1_capture` shaders. This is not a before/after claim; water color and broad visual parity remain incomplete.
- A matched Complementary shadow fixture on the earlier shadow-fix candidate showed a natural golem cast shadow (ROI luminance MAE 5.33 vs Iris, down from 22.67) and the strengthened depth/color-alias fixture passed 8,788 active / 0 disabled pixels. Generated-scene evidence does not certify natural worlds.

# Veyra 0.2.0-beta.49+mc1.21.11 - experimental prerelease

Beta.49 includes the beta.48 shadow-depth and sign-text routing fixes, then adds Iris-style loose-uniform suppliers, directional block shading and entity color overlays. It also enables declared color outputs for shadow-entity pipelines. Two forced-near-depth fixtures show shadow entity depth writes with centered geometry and with pack XY preserved, but they override z and do not validate the natural shadow depth or placement. Full Iris visual parity and stable compatibility are not claimed.

## Changes

- **Entity shadow color:** Enable declared fragment color outputs for shadow-entity pipelines and add a regression fixture with a constant entity output to isolate color writes from custom varying linkage (#137).
- **Entity overlays:** Convert vanilla entity and hurt overlay colors using Iris' `entityColor` rules (#136).
- **Directional shading:** Match Iris face shading unless the shader pack enables `oldLighting` (#135).
- **Loose uniforms:** Attach VulkanMod value suppliers to generated UBO 0 fields across geometry pipelines (#134).
- **Shadow depth and sign text:** Preserve Vulkan shadow depth remapping and Iris `BlockTrans` sign-text routing, including the pack vertex stage and native alpha cutoff (#131, #132).
- **Other fixes:** Honor shadow-entity toggles and drain deferred Vulkan image frees before allocator destruction (#128, #130).

## Installation

- Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer, VulkanMod 0.6.8, and Java 21 or newer.
- Install `veyra-0.2.0-beta.49+mc1.21.11.jar` beside VulkanMod. Keep only one Veyra JAR in the instance and do not install the sources JAR.
- Put shaderpack folders or ZIPs in `shaderpacks`. Press F6 to select a pack, then use Configure / Apply for supported options and profiles.

## Validation and known limits

- PR #137 head `0ed7859` passed the exact-head Build, shaderpack source-audit and Graphics smoke workflows and was merged into `main` at `72de931`.
- The rebuilt beta.49 candidate passed the local Temurin JDK 21 gate: 597 tests with 0 failures, errors or skips; `build`, `validateShaders`, `packageExamplePacks`, `compileGraphicsSmokeJava`, 104 example shaders and 122 Vulkan SPIR-V compilations. The pinned source audit covered 4 packs, 3 dimensions, 12 defaults and 63 declared-profile cases: 939 geometry fragments accepted / 0 rejected and 18 active compute stages compiled / 0 rejected.
- The published CI assets were downloaded and checked against `SHA256SUMS.txt`; the mod JAR passed `scripts/verify_jar.py` for Minecraft 1.21.11 / VulkanMod 0.6.8. Published JAR: 1,068,837 bytes, SHA-256 `a9f3c296a2a67ef94208996126496030b4b2cc8cb46c664067d06b5b2e9d3da4`. Example-packs ZIP: 132,059 bytes, SHA-256 `60069e074bbeaac8d575a816a2dfedcf1fa63f27e279edc4c6462b63163e0475`. The CI archives differ in bytes from the local preflight build; use the published checksum manifest.
- The pinned source audit accepted 939 geometry fragments with none rejected and compiled all 18 selected compute stages across four pinned packs, three dimensions, 12 defaults and 63 declared-profile cases. All 75 records are source-only; 18 Complementary Reimagined/Unbound profile-dimension cases need `vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics` for `voxel_img` shadow-vertex writes, unavailable on the audit device.
- The targeted RTX 3070 shadow-color fixture passed with 9,256 strict-magenta active marker samples / 0 after disabling the pack. No Vulkan validation layer was enabled. Earlier third-party pack captures and lifecycle runs in `COMPATIBILITY.md` were made on beta.47/beta.48 code and are not fresh full-pack validation of beta.49.
- Entity shadow depth remains unresolved: the centered forced-depth probe recorded 20,656 magenta samples; a second probe preserving pack XY recorded 205, with 0 after disabling the pack. Both override z, so they confirm writes under probe geometry but not the natural shadow depth or placement.

# Veyra 0.2.0-beta.48+mc1.21.11 - experimental prerelease

Beta.48 fixes a Vulkan depth-space mismatch in shader-pack shadow geometry and selects Iris' shadow projection for entity shadow vertex mains. Complementary Reimagined HIGH is substantially brighter than the beta.47 capture, though it remains darker than Iris; this release does not claim full visual parity.

## Changes

- **Shadow depth:** Terrain and entity shadow pack vertex stages now map OpenGL clip depth `[-w,w]` to Vulkan zero-to-one after the pack entry point. Entity shadow legacy projection forms (`ftransform()`, `gl_ProjectionMatrix` and `gl_ModelViewProjectionMatrix`) use Iris `shadowProjection` (#132).
- **Loose uniforms and shadow toggles:** Shader-pack loose uniforms now receive VulkanMod suppliers in geometry pipelines, and `shadowEntities` / `shadowBlockEntities` options are honored (#127, #128).
- **Shutdown:** Drain deferred Vulkan image frees before allocator destruction (#130).
- **Sign text routing:** Carry block-entity text identity to the renderer, select Iris `BlockTrans`, load its pack vertex stage, and preserve native alpha cutoff (#131). Sildur glyph readability is still unverified.

## Installation

- Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer, VulkanMod 0.6.8, and Java 21 or newer.
- Install `veyra-0.2.0-beta.48+mc1.21.11.jar` beside VulkanMod. Keep only one Veyra JAR in the instance and do not install the sources JAR.
- Put shaderpack folders or ZIPs in `shaderpacks`. Press F6 to select a pack, then use Configure / Apply for supported options and profiles.

## Validation and known limits

- On an RTX 3070, pinned Complementary Reimagined r5.9.3 HIGH passed the 640x360 generated-scene smoke (230,400 non-black pixels / 116 color buckets). Compared with Iris 1.10.8 + Sodium 0.8.14, candidate mean RGB was 106.82/98.85/72.82 vs 121.49/108.53/80.95; mean absolute error was 17.69. The remaining brightness difference is unresolved.
- Selected-profile lifecycle evidence for BSL HIGH, Sildur default, Complementary Unbound HIGH and COMPLEMENTARY is recorded in `COMPATIBILITY.md`. These runs use generated scenes and do not certify natural worlds or whole packs. Sildur sign glyph readability remains unverified.
- Exact-head PR #132 checks passed: Build, pinned shaderpack source audit, and all 30 Lavapipe Graphics jobs. The full JDK 21 gate passed 595 tests, 104 example shaders and 122 Vulkan SPIR-V compilations.
- A previous Windows shutdown ended once with status `0xC0000409`; a later candidate run exited normally after #130, but the historical status is not fully explained.

Veyra remains an experimental Iris-compatible subset. Full Iris visual parity and stable compatibility are not claimed.

releases.notes:
# Veyra 0.2.0-beta.47+mc1.21.11 - experimental prerelease

Beta.47 fixes loose shader-pack uniforms that were zero in sky, particle, weather and entity shaders, and honours Iris' shadow entity toggles. This restores valid values in the affected passes and lets the tested Complementary Unbound COMPLEMENTARY profile load; it does not establish full Iris visual parity.

## Changes

- **Loose uniforms:** VulkanMod gathers loose shader-pack uniforms (`sunAngle`, `worldTime`, `viewWidth`, ...) into a generated block that `RenderPipeline` draws never filled, so sky, particle, weather, entity and shadow-entity shaders read 0. Complementary derived a pre-dawn time of day from that: black sky, no clouds, night lighting. Those passes now read the real values (PR #127).
- **Shadow entity toggles:** `shadowEntities` and `shadowBlockEntities` from `shaders.properties` (option-preprocessed, default true) now skip entity or block-entity submissions in the shadow pass. Complementary disables block-entity shadows; Veyra previously still routed them to a `shadow_block` program that, under the COMPLEMENTARY profile, declares a writable `voxel_img` and disabled the pack (PR #128).

## Installation

- Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer, VulkanMod 0.6.8, and Java 21 or newer.
- Install `veyra-0.2.0-beta.47+mc1.21.11.jar` beside VulkanMod. Keep only one Veyra JAR in the instance and do not install the sources JAR.
- Put shaderpack folders or ZIPs in `shaderpacks`. Press F6 to select a pack and Configure / Apply to edit supported options and profiles.

## Validation and known limits

- Iris 1.10.8 + Sodium 0.8.14 reference of the same Complementary Reimagined HIGH fixture: Veyra's sky, clouds, wall and layout match after #127. At 640×360, Veyra's Vulkan readback and Minecraft Screenshot API capture are pixel-identical (MAE 0 per RGB channel). Against Iris' Screenshot API capture, Veyra remains darker (mean RGB 57.84/58.45/52.45 vs 121.49/108.53/80.95); the capture method does not explain the gap, and its rendering/color-space cause is unconfirmed.
- RTX 3070 lifecycle runs (resize, Nether and return, disable/re-enable, resource reload): BSL HIGH 360,000 px / 124 buckets, Sildur's Vibrant default 360,000 / 122, Complementary Unbound HIGH 358,109 / 92, Unbound COMPLEMENTARY 359,042 / 93 (previously failed). All passed.
- PRs #127 and #128 each passed all 57 hosted checks before merging. The release workflow repeats the pinned source audit, full Lavapipe matrix, versioned build/tests and distributable verification.
- Not certified: exact Iris visual parity, natural-world visuals and Sildur sign text. The earlier one-off Windows shutdown exit (0xC0000409) remains unexplained; a later candidate smoke exited normally but did not reproduce that failure or prove its fix.

Veyra remains an experimental Iris-compatible subset and does not claim stable Iris parity. See COMPATIBILITY.md and ARCHITECTURE.md for the measured scope.
